raw:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM rulings r
WHERE r.uuid IN (
    SELECT uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged'
      AND setCode = 'ORI'
)
AND r.date >= '2015-06-01'
AND r.date < '2015-07-01';
```
